tagline: Skills For CEOs Who Prompt To Profit

classrooms.name: START HERE: CEO ORIENTATION
classrooms.description: Welcome to the DGL BY RJ Vault. Start here to learn how the community works, set up your profile, pick your learning path, and finish your first win in your first 7 days.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members know the rules, how to find everything, which path to follow, and they have posted their first introduction and first AI creation.

modules.name: Welcome to the Vault
lessons: A welcome from RJ: what DGL x P2P means
How to ask for help so you get answers fast
modules.assignment: Post your introduction in the community: your name, what you create now, and the one skill you came here to master.

modules.name: Set Up Your CEO Toolkit
lessons: The affordable AI app stack (what you need and what you don't)
Setting up your accounts and folders
How to save and organize your prompts
modules.assignment: Set up your prompt folder and screenshot your toolkit checklist.

modules.name: Choose Your Path
lessons: The 3 learning paths: Beginner, Creator, Business
Your first 7 days, step by step
How levels, points and unlocks work in the Vault
modules.assignment: Comment which path you chose and finish the Day 1 task.

classrooms.name: THE PROMPTING LAB
classrooms.description: The core of DGL x P2P. Learn RJ's prompting method and tested prompt structures, and the workflows that get premium results from affordable AI apps.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can write structured prompts that give consistent, realistic, controllable results in any image or video app, and can debug a prompt that isn't working.

modules.name: Prompting Foundations
lessons: Why the prompt matters more than the app
The anatomy of a strong prompt: subject, scene, style, camera, light
Writing prompts in plain language vs structured formats
Negative prompts and what to leave out
modules.assignment: Rewrite one weak prompt three times using the anatomy framework and post all three results.

modules.name: The DGL x P2P Method
lessons: The DGL x P2P framework explained
Debugging: why a prompt fails and how to fix it
modules.assignment: Build your first reusable template and test it on three different subjects.

modules.name: Advanced Prompt Engineering
lessons: Structured and code-style prompts (JSON and parameter formats)
Camera and lens language for realism
Using AI chat assistants to write and refine prompts
modules.assignment: Create one structured (code-style) prompt and compare it side by side with a plain-language version.

resources: RJ's tested prompt templates [RJ TO ADD]

classrooms.name: AI PHOTO STUDIO
classrooms.description: Create realistic AI images: portraits, fashion, lifestyle and product photography, with the same character in every shot.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can produce realistic, brand-ready photos and keep a person or product looking the same across a full photo set.

modules.name: Realistic Portraits
lessons: What makes an AI image look real vs fake
Skin, hands, eyes: fixing the common giveaways
Portrait lighting setups in prompt form
modules.assignment: Create a 3-image portrait set of one person in three different lighting setups.

modules.name: Fashion and Lifestyle
lessons: Lifestyle and 'day in the life' scenes
Luxury aesthetic: building the black, white and chrome look
modules.assignment: Create a 4-image fashion carousel with one consistent model.

modules.name: Product Photography
lessons: Product shots for brands and clients
Placing real products into AI scenes
Building a product photo set for an online store
modules.assignment: Create a 3-image product set for a real or sample product.

modules.name: Editing and Upscaling
modules.assignment: Post a before-and-after of an image you fixed.

resources: Product photo prompt pack [RJ TO ADD]

classrooms.name: AI VIDEO PRODUCTION
classrooms.description: Turn images and ideas into cinematic AI video. Covers Seedance workflows, multi-scene stories, motion prompting and editing a finished reel.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can plan, generate and edit a multi-scene AI video with consistent characters, ready to post.

modules.name: AI Video Foundations
lessons: Motion prompting: describing movement and camera moves
Choosing the right video app for the job
modules.assignment: Generate one 5-second clip from text and one from an image, using the same subject.

modules.name: Seedance Workflows
lessons: Seedance prompt structure for realistic motion
Multi-shot and scene control in Seedance
modules.assignment: Create a 3-shot Seedance sequence with one character.

modules.name: Multi-Scene Storytelling
lessons: Shot lists and storyboards with AI
modules.assignment: Storyboard and produce a 15–30 second multi-scene story.

modules.name: Editing and Delivery
lessons: Cover frames and hooks in the first 2 seconds
modules.assignment: Post your finished reel in the Showcase with your shot list.

classrooms.name: AI APP VAULT
classrooms.description: Walkthroughs of the AI apps worth using, affordable alternatives to expensive tools, side-by-side model comparisons, and updates as the apps change.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can pick the right affordable app for any task and keep up when apps and models change.

modules.name: Image Apps
lessons: Image app walkthroughs [RJ TO ADD: current apps]
modules.assignment: Run one prompt in two apps and post the comparison.

modules.name: Video Apps
lessons: Video app walkthroughs [RJ TO ADD: current apps]
Credits, pricing and getting the most per dollar
modules.assignment: Share which video app fits your budget and why.

modules.name: Assistant, Voice and Editing Apps
lessons: AI chat assistants for prompts, scripts and captions
modules.assignment: Build your personal stack list: one app per job.

modules.name: Monthly App Updates
lessons: How to evaluate a new app in 15 minutes
modules.assignment: Review one new app with the 15-minute method.

classrooms.name: AI CHARACTER UNIVERSITY
classrooms.description: Create AI characters who look the same in every image and video. Covers reference sheets, identity locks, wardrobe and personality, and characters that can carry a series.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can design an original character and keep it recognizable across photos, videos and episodes.

modules.name: Character Design
lessons: Designing an original character from scratch
Writing the character bible: look, personality, backstory
modules.assignment: Write a one-page character bible for your first character.

modules.name: Reference Sheets and Identity Locks
lessons: Identity locks: the details that keep a face consistent
modules.assignment: Create a reference sheet with front, side, and 3/4 views.

modules.name: Characters in Motion
lessons: Wardrobe and scene changes without losing identity
Building a cast that works together
modules.assignment: Put your character in 3 different scenes and 1 video clip.

classrooms.name: DRAMA AI STUDIOS
classrooms.description: Produce AI drama and reality shows: concepts, casting, scripts, episodes and cliffhangers that keep viewers coming back for the next part.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can plan and produce an original multi-episode AI drama series with a repeatable production workflow.

modules.name: Show Development
lessons: Finding a drama concept that hooks
Formats: reality show, soap, confessional, mystery
Show bible: premise, cast, conflict, season arc
modules.assignment: Write the show bible for your drama series.

modules.name: Casting and Scripts
lessons: Dialogue, tension and the cliffhanger ending
modules.assignment: Cast your show and write the Episode 1 script.

modules.name: Episode Production
lessons: Producing an episode end to end
Series packaging: titles, covers, part numbers
modules.assignment: Produce and post Episode 1 in the Showcase.

classrooms.name: RELATIONSHIP AI STUDIOS
classrooms.description: Create AI couples and relationship stories: characters, chemistry, relatable moments and ongoing love-story series that audiences connect with.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can build an AI couple with real chemistry and produce a relatable, ongoing relationship series.

modules.name: Building the Couple
lessons: Designing a couple viewers root for
Chemistry on camera: poses, expressions, closeness
modules.assignment: Create your couple's reference sheet and 3 photos together.

modules.name: Relationship Storytelling
lessons: Relatable formats: red flags and green flags, POV, 'when he/she…'
modules.assignment: Write 5 relatable post concepts for your couple.

modules.name: Series Production
lessons: Planning a relationship series by season
modules.assignment: Produce and post the first episode of your couple series.

classrooms.name: FACELESS CONTENT SYSTEMS
classrooms.description: Build and grow a faceless page powered by AI: choose a niche, brand the page, batch content, and build systems that keep it running without you on camera.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can launch a branded faceless page with a content system that holds up for 30 days of posting.

modules.name: Faceless Page Strategy
modules.assignment: Submit your faceless page concept: niche, name, 3 sample posts.

modules.name: Content Systems
lessons: Batch-creating a week of content in one session
modules.assignment: Batch-create 7 posts and share your process.

modules.name: Growth and Consistency
lessons: When to change course vs stay consistent
modules.assignment: Post for 14 days and share your analytics review.

classrooms.name: SOCIAL MEDIA CEO SCHOOL
classrooms.description: Instagram growth for CEOs: how the algorithm works, hooks, engagement, captions that sell, Stories and DMs, so content brings in followers and customers.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can run a content strategy that grows reach and turns viewers into leads and customers.

modules.name: How the Algorithm Works
lessons: How Instagram ranks Reels, posts and Stories
Shares, saves and watch time: what to optimize
modules.assignment: Audit your profile with the conversion checklist.

modules.name: Content That Grows
lessons: Hooks: the first 2 seconds and the first line
Captions that sell without sounding salesy
modules.assignment: Write 10 hooks and 3 sales captions for your pillars.

modules.name: Engagement and Conversion
modules.assignment: Run one comment-keyword campaign and report what you learned.

classrooms.name: DIGITAL PRODUCT EMPIRE
classrooms.description: Turn your AI skills into digital products: prompt packs, templates, guides and mini-courses, with the offers, funnels and systems to sell them.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can create, price, package and launch their first digital product with a simple sales funnel.

modules.name: Product Creation
lessons: Finding a product people will pay for
modules.assignment: Outline your first product and its target buyer.

modules.name: Offers and Pricing
modules.assignment: Write your offer and price it.

modules.name: Funnels and Launch
lessons: A simple funnel: content to DM to checkout
modules.assignment: Launch your product and share your launch plan.

classrooms.name: CLIENT SERVICES & DFY
classrooms.description: Sell your AI content skills as a service: done-for-you content, client acquisition, pricing, contracts, delivery and keeping clients coming back.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can package a done-for-you AI content service, find clients, price it, and deliver professionally.

modules.name: Packaging Your Service
lessons: Services you can offer with AI skills
modules.assignment: Create your service menu with 3 packages.

modules.name: Getting Clients
lessons: Where clients are and how to reach them
modules.assignment: Send 10 outreach messages and share your results honestly.

modules.name: Delivery and Retention
modules.assignment: Write your client onboarding checklist.

resources: Simple service agreement outline (have it reviewed locally)

classrooms.name: CEO RESULTS & STUDENT SHOWCASE
classrooms.description: Post your assignments, get feedback, and celebrate real wins. This is where Vault members show their work and level up together.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members get regular feedback and build a portfolio of finished work.

modules.name: How to Submit Work
lessons: How to post an assignment for feedback
modules.assignment: Submit your first assignment for feedback.

modules.name: Wins Wall
modules.assignment: Share one win, big or small.

classrooms.name: RJ'S RESOURCE VAULT
classrooms.description: Every prompt library, template, download, code and reference from the Vault, organized in one place.
classrooms.learning_outcome: Members can find any resource in under a minute.

modules.name: Codes and References
lessons: Vocabulary references: camera, light, motion, style
